plan.title: Closed RFQ Edit Evaluation Time Cancel

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the RFQ event.
Use the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the scenario.
Restrict evaluation reopening according to the case configuration.
Record that the existing vendor bid is still displayed before opening the dialog.
Record that the existing bid price is displayed before the cancellation attempt.
Open the RFQ Settings action that launches the Edit Evaluation Time window.
Confirm the Edit Evaluation Time window opened.
Cancel the evaluation-time edit without saving changes.
Verify that cancelling closes the Edit Evaluation Time window.
Verify the closed event state remains visible after cancellation.
Verify the vendor information remains unchanged after cancellation.
Verify the existing bid price remains unchanged after cancellation.
